events.title: 셰필드 유나이티드 are still looking for a league win 15 games into the season, with just four points to their name, after losing 2–1 at 애스턴 빌라 , while 더비 카운티's upswing continues and they climb to 14th place with a 2–1 win at 선덜랜드, who stand 16th. A Lee Sharpe goal gives 맨체스터 유나이티드 a 1–0 win at 에버턴, United's first win at Goodison Park since January 1982. There is thrilling action in the Second Division when a 5–4 win for the hosts at Filbert Street sees David Kelly score a hat-trick for 레스터 시티 and Micky Quinn score a hat-trick for 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 . The result helps lift 레스터 시티 clear of the relegation zone, while 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 are now 16th in the Second Division and six points adrift of the playoffs, mounting the pressure on manager Jim Smith who had almost delivered 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 promotion last season. 웨스트햄 유나이티드 remain top of the Second Division with a 3–1 home win over 웨스트브로미치 앨비언, 포트 베일 close in on the playoffs with a 5–1 home win over Plymouth, Oldham retain second place with a 6–1 home win over Brighton, and 미들즈브러 go third win a 3–0 home win over Hull.
아스널 end 리버풀's unbeaten League run by beating them 3–0 at Highbury , cutting the gap at the top to two points.
루턴 타운 win the Soccer Six at the G-Mex Centre , beating 리버풀 4–0 in the final.

Heavy snow causes many Football League and FA Cup fixtures to be postponed, but a decent number of matches in the less seriously affected areas go ahead. 아스널 miss the chance to go ahead at the top of the table on goal difference when they are held to a 1–1 draw at Luton. 토트넘 홋스퍼 draw 3–3 at home to 선덜랜드. The first match between 맨체스터 유나이티드 and 리즈 유나이티드 at Old Trafford for nearly a decade ends in a 1–1 draw. 에버턴 increase Coventry's relegation worries and boost their own chances of staying clear of relegation with a 1–0 win at Goodison Park. 웨스트햄 유나이티드 remain firmly in the lead at the top of the Second Division with a 1–0 win at struggling 포츠머스.
AC 밀란 again wins the Intercontinental Cup in FC 도쿄 , this time by defeating Paraguay's Olimpia Asunción (3–0). 프랑크 레이카르트 scores twice for the Italians.
사우샘프턴 pay £1million for a player for the first time in their history by signing midfielder Alan McLoughlin from 스윈던 타운 .

리버풀 are four points ahead at the top of the First Division, with a game in hand, after beating 셰필드 유나이티드 2–0 to leave their hosts winless and still with only four points to their name so far this season, while 아스널 are held to a 2–2 draw at home to 윔블던. A 10-goal thriller at the Baseball Ground sees 첼시 beat 더비 카운티 6–4. QPR remain second from bottom with a 2–1 defeat at home to 노팅엄 포리스트.

아스널 captain 토니 애덤스 is sentenced to four months in prison for drink-driving after being more than three times over the legal alcohol limit when he crashed his car in Southend-on-Sea on 6 May this year. Adams, 24, is also fined £500 and banned from driving for two years.
Oldham go top of the Second Division on goal difference with a 5–3 home win over Plymouth.

셰필드 유나이티드 beat 노팅엄 포리스트 to win their first First Division game of the season at the seventeenth attempt, but remain bottom of the table. 리버풀 remain comfortably in the lead at the top of the table with a 3–2 home win over 사우샘프턴. 맨체스터 유나이티드 win 3–1 at 윔블던. 웨스트햄 유나이티드 miss out on the chance to return to the top of the Second Division with a 1–0 defeat at 반즐리.

The last matches before Christmas are played. 아스널 extend their unbeaten start to the season to 18 games with a goalless draw at 애스턴 빌라, although 리버풀 are still six points ahead of them and have a game in hand. QPR miss the chance to climb out of the relegation zone when 더비 카운티 hold them to a 1–1 draw at the Baseball Ground. Leeds hold on to fifth place with a 1–0 win over 선덜랜드 at Roker Park . Three players are sent off in a goalless draw between 레스터 시티 and 왓퍼드 at Filbert Street . In the Third Division, 브렌트퍼드 boost their hopes of winning promotion in Phil Holder 's first season in management by beating 위건 애슬레틱 1–0 at Griffin Park . In the Fourth Division, 칼라일 유나이티드 keep their playoff hopes alive with a 1–0 win over 블랙풀 , who are now 18th in the table.

The Boxing Day action in the First Division sees leaders 리버풀 held to a 1–1 draw by QPR at Loftus Road , allowing 아스널 to cut their lead to four points (with a game in hand) by beating 더비 카운티 3–0 at Highbury. Coventry boost their survival bid with a 2–0 home win over 토트넘 홋스퍼. 크리스털 팰리스 remain in the hunt for the title with a 2–1 home win over 선덜랜드. Leeds go fourth with a 4–1 home win over 첼시. 셰필드 유나이티드 make it back-to-back victories by winning 1–0 at Luton. 맨체스터 유나이티드 beat 노리치 시티 3–0 at Old Trafford , ending Dave Stringer 's team's run of five victories in their previous clashes between the two sides. 웨스트햄 유나이티드 go back to the top of the Second Division with a 2–0 home win over Oldham. 브리스틀 시티 beat 포츠머스 4–1 to move to the brink of the playoff zone and boost their chances of a second successive promotion, while the bottom two of Hull and Oxford draw 3–3 at Boothferry Park .

아스널 cut 리버풀's lead of the First Division to a single point by beating 셰필드 유나이티드 4–1 at Highbury, although 케니 달글리시 's men still have two games in hand. Leeds go third with a 3–0 home win over 윔블던. Coventry, 에버턴, QPR and 사우샘프턴 all claim victories in their fight to avoid relegation. There is no shortage of excitement in the Second Division, including Oxford climbing five places off the bottom of the table with a 3–1 win over 블랙번 로버스 at Ewood Park . 입스위치 타운 and Charlton draw 4–4 at Portman Road . 뉴캐슬 유나이티드's frustrating season continues with a 2–0 home defeat to 노츠 카운티, which leaves them rooted in the bottom half of the table.
The last fixture of 1990 sees 리버풀 lose 1–0 to 크리스털 팰리스 at Selhurst Park, which boosts 스티브 코펠 's side's hopes of winning their first ever major trophy in the shape of the league title.

The year ends with 아스널, still unbeaten but having had two points deducted, one point behind of 리버풀 at the top of the First Division. 크리스털 팰리스 and 리즈 유나이티드 occupy third and fourth respectively, while 셰필드 유나이티드 remain bottom of the table and 선덜랜드 have slipped into the bottom two. 웨스트햄 유나이티드 stand top of the Second Division, followed in second place by 올덤 애슬레틱 and in third place by 셰필드 웬즈데이. 미들즈브러, 노츠 카운티, 울버햄프턴 원더러스 and 브리스틀 시티 occupy the playoff zone. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드, who began the season among the favourites for promotion, occupy a lowly 16th place and are just four points above the relegation zone that threatens them with Third Division football for the first time.
